content.title: Natural gas storage leader Rockpoint files for Canadian IPO
content.summary: Investing.com -- Rockpoint Gas Storage Inc., a Brookfield Infrastructure-backed operator of natural gas storage facilities, is preparing to enter public markets through an initial public offering on the Toronto Stock Exchange. The IPO will consist of a primary treasury offering and a potential secondary offering contingent on the exercise of an Over-Allotment Option by underwriters, with Brookfield affiliates acting as the selling shareholders.
